remarks: Modern Loft-Style Living in the Heart of South Norwalk  Freshly painted and professionally cleaned, this bright and airy unit features high ceilings, oversized windows, and bamboo wood flooring throughout. Enjoy the vibrant SoNo lifestyle-just steps from restaurants, bars, boutique shops, and local parks.  The building offers secure keypad entry, video surveillance, and elevator access. Conveniently located within walking distance to Metro North and local bus routes, and only a 5-minute drive to the beach and recreational areas. Credit check required.
